# kiro-plan-basic

021 regression world: the reported kiro implementation-plan shape — one `# Implementation Plan`
title heading plus thirteen column-0 checkbox tasks with local ids `1`–`10` (including `4.1`–`4.3`,
the `4.` task body-less) at `.kiro/specs/auth/tasks.md`, driven at shipped defaults. The pre-fix
parser collapsed the whole file into a single giant issue; post-fix the engine must create 14 issues
(the title-heading task + the 13 checklist tasks), each description holding only its own task region,
and re-plan must be idempotent (0 actions). Single route: everything defaults to `TEAM-A`/`proj-alpha`.
Placeholder identifiers only (Principle III).
